sources.entry: wger - Web-based personal workout, fitness and weight logger/tracker. It can also be used as a simple gym management utility and offers a full REST API as well. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Python/Docker

summary.one_liner: wger is a free, open-source, self-hostable web app for logging workouts, fitness progress, body weight, diet and nutrition, with a REST API and basic gym management features.
summary.what_it_does: wger lets users build custom workout routines with automatic weight progression rules and track body weight, diet plans, and custom measurements. It includes a nutrition log backed by a food database from Open Food Facts for counting calories. A progress gallery lets users upload photos over time, and a built-in exercise wiki can be accessed and contributed to. It offers a REST API for third-party integrations or automations, and includes multi-user support with basic gym management features. The README says it can be deployed with Docker and is translated into multiple languages via Weblate; it also mentions companion apps on Android, iOS, F-Droid, and Flathub.
use_cases: log daily calories and diet plans
record body measurements and progress photos
automate fitness data through a REST API
notable: Automatic weight progression rules within custom workout routines
Nutrition logging using the Open Food Facts food database
Full REST API for integrations and automations
Community-maintained exercise and ingredient data under free licenses
Companion apps listed for Android, iOS, F-Droid, and Flathub
caveats: The README points to external documentation for detailed installation, so setup beyond the single docker compose command is not described here
Exercise and ingredient data carry varying Creative Commons licenses per entry
